gate_S1: pooled normalised recall of chosen model > rule-ranked list; paired two-level bootstrap 95% interval of the difference > 0 (2,000 replicates, seed 20261112); exact one-sided sign-flip p < 0.05 on the 13 per-run differences
condition_S3: calibration-in-the-large in [-0.2, 0.2] and slope in [0.8, 1.2], pooled, no recalibration
fairness_FR1: groups disability=Y, imd 0-10%, imd Missing; flag if recall gap < -10 points and Holm-adjusted one-sided bootstrap p < 0.05 (5,000 replicates)
tie_breaker: uniform draw per enrolment, seed 20261112, key order
